Ultra low EMF in this catalogue means 3 to 5 mG, roughly half the field of a standard low EMF cabin. From $2,299.

Ask the measuring distance

Most cabins here publish an mG figure, which is the highest disclosure rate of the three tiers we stock. Rather fewer say what distance they measured at, and that is the part that decides whether two numbers can be compared at all. A reading taken 6 inches from the panel is not the same claim as one taken at 2 inches.

What else is in here

Almost every cabin states a capacity, running one to six people. Most run on a standard 120V circuit, so they fit a normal room without an electrician. Where a maximum temperature is published it is 140°F or below.

The other two tiers are near zero EMF at 2 to 3 mG and low EMF at 5 to 10 mG. Each is a different product for a different buyer, not three names for one thing.

Delivery

Free shipping to the lower 48, no minimum, and it stops at the curb — the crate is left at the end of your driveway. Getting it inside is a $600 white-glove upgrade. Getting it inside and assembled is $1,800, which covers everything except electrical work: we recommend you hire a local electrician for that, because the wiring has to meet your local code and pass local inspection. Service fees are non-refundable: if the sauna goes back, the installation does not.
